verdict.rationale: Pilot is a done-for-you professional accounting, bookkeeping and tax service (its llms.txt lists the category as Professional Services). Users don't author automations they could version, review or roll back, so this axis is a category error for the product type. The 'Custom workflows and reporting' line describes a service-tier offering, not user-managed automations with version control, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
